title: Why Type II Collagen Should Be Part of Your Daily Supplement Routine | Herbal Pharmacist
abstract:
When we consider staying mobile and active as we age—or simply keeping up with a demanding lifestyle—joint health often takes center stage. Yet, many individuals overlook a crucial nutrient that can make a significant difference: **Type II collagen**, especially in the clinically studied form known as **Collavant n2®**.  
Backed by science and sourced from native (undenatured) Type II collagen, Collavant n2 has become a game-changer in the field of joint support. Let’s explore why this ingredient deserves a permanent place in your daily supplement stack.
## What Is Type II Collagen and Why Does It Matter?  
Collagen is the most abundant protein in your body, but not all types of collagen are the same. Specifically, Type II collagen constitutes the majority of the cartilage found in your joints. As we age or experience wear and tear from physical activity, this cartilage starts to degrade, resulting in stiffness, discomfort, and reduced mobility.  
What sets Collavant n2® apart is its delivery of **undenatured (native) Type II collagen**, which maintains its natural three-dimensional structure. This intact form is crucial to its function in the body, activating immune tolerance and reducing joint swelling instead of merely acting as a protein source.
## Science-Backed Benefits of Collavant n2  
#### Improves Joint Mobility  
[Clinical](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35612617/) studies show that undenatured Type II collagen can improve knee extension and joint flexibility. In one [randomized trial](https://www.oarsijournal.com/article/S1063-4584%2824%2901045-8/fulltext), healthy adults who supplemented with undenatured Type II collagen experienced improved knee range of motion compared to placebo, particularly after strenuous physical activity.  
This makes Collavant n2 ideal not just for aging adults, but also for weekend warriors and fitness enthusiasts looking to stay agile and limber.
